overview: A complete Bangladeshi reseller/e-commerce dashboard web app with a mobile-first Android-like UI. Fully in Bangla language with stylish Bangla fonts, green and white theme, animated sidebar, bottom navigation, product listings, daily stats, and profile management.
features: 100% Bangla language UI with Hind Siliguri/Noto Sans Bengali fonts
Mobile-first app shell with 430px max-width, green and white theme
Animated sidebar with dark/light mode toggle
Home page with banner carousel, social links, notice marquee, and 30-item dashboard grid
Product catalog with search, category filters, and cart management
Daily stats with animated counters, weekly bar chart, and sales report table
Profile page with wallet, order/income history, and referral info
React Context + useReducer state with localStorage persistence
